title: Kickin Crunchy Cornish Brown Rice Noodles Afternoon Tea
description: A spicy and crunchy one-pot British dish featuring brown rice noodles, perfect for a unique afternoon tea experience. This nut-free-friendly recipe is sure to delight.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the brown rice noodles, cornish sea salt, smoked paprika, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir the noodles occasionally to prevent sticking.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it steam for 5 minutes.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
